instruction: Navigate to the account sign-in or login page.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding login/account page. Same navigation difficulty. Evaluator checks URL contains 'login', 'signin', OR 'account' pattern (regex OR) using existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correct: get_active_tab_info can extract active tab URL from accessibility tree and return dict with 'url', 'title', 'content' fields
Metric logic correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match properly handles both string URL and dict with 'url' field (chrome.py:79-87)
Pattern semantically correct: Single regex pattern 'login|signin|account' uses OR logic to match URLs containing any of these keywords
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks for login/signin/account pages as required by instruction 'Navigate to the account sign-in or login page'
Data flow correct: Getter returns active tab info dict -> Metric extracts URL -> Regex search matches if URL contains login OR signin OR account
No edge case issues: Pattern handles different URL formats for login pages (e.g., /login, /signin, /account, etc.)
